title: RuntimeConfig
description: Full MEDRE runtime configuration structure. Adapter transport names are extensible; installed adapter configuration models validate their fields. medre config check is the authoritative validator, including installed-provider availability, cross-adapter identifiers, and route semantics.

shutdown_drain_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for in-flight work to drain during graceful shutdown.

delivery_acquire_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for acquiring a delivery slot when the in-flight limit is reached.

max_inflight_inbound_admissions.description: Maximum concurrently admitted inbound events across all adapters.

inbound_admission_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds an inbound arrival may wait for an admission slot before rejection.

level.description: MEDRE namespace logger level (e.g. DEBUG, INFO, WARNING). Case-insensitive at load time — uppercase enum matches the canonical level names enforced by the loader.

overrides.description: Per-logger namespace level overrides keyed by logger name (e.g. nio: WARNING).

backend.description: Storage backend identifier. Only sqlite and memory are supported at runtime.

path.description: Storage path. Null means the default {state}/medre.sqlite is used.

enabled.description: Whether the background retry worker is active.

interval_seconds.description: Polling interval in seconds for checking due outbox work.

batch_size.description: Maximum due outbox items claimed per polling cycle.

max_attempts.description: Maximum total delivery attempts before dead-lettering.

attachments.description: Generic durable-attachment relay policy (AttachmentConfig). Disabled by default: while enabled is false, no attachment bytes are fetched, stored, or transferred, and media events carry honest unavailable descriptors. Range and cross-field validation (positive integers, max_attachment_bytes <= max_retained_bytes, max_concurrent_transfers >= 1, positive finite timeout, booleans are not integers) is enforced by the typed config dataclass at load time.

enabled.description: Master switch for retaining and transferring attachment bytes. When false, previously retained bytes are not transferred either.

max_attachment_bytes.description: Maximum measured size of one primary attachment in bytes (default 10 MiB). Must not exceed max_retained_bytes.

max_retained_bytes.description: Maximum total of unique retained attachment bytes in bytes (default 256 MiB). Reaching the quota rejects new content explicitly; nothing is evicted — no retention, TTL, or GC. Raising capacity is an operator action.

max_concurrent_transfers.description: Maximum concurrent binary transfers (downloads and uploads combined) across the whole runtime.

transfer_timeout_seconds.description: Deadline in seconds for one binary transfer.

adapters.description: Adapter instances grouped by transport entry-point name. The schema validates structure for any provider; medre config check rejects transports without an installed provider and validates provider-owned settings. An empty mapping is valid when no installed provider contributes an offline sample; runtime startup still requires an enabled adapter.

routes.description: Route definitions keyed by route_id. Each value is a RouteConfig table. Detailed route policy / retry / context_map validation is done by routing-config.schema.json and the typed RouteConfig dataclass at load time.

RouteEntry.title: RouteEntry
RouteEntry.$comment: Guided authoring validates the existing document before context entry. Disabled routes retain reference validation but do not count as active duplicate deliveries. These cross-route checks belong to typed configuration and the route compiler, not this structural schema.
RouteEntry.description: A single route definition. Its identifier is the routes mapping key: a non-empty string of ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, with no line terminators. An entry-level route_id field is not accepted. Policy / retry / context_map are modelled as plain objects here; their internal shape is enforced by the component schema and the typed dataclass.

forward_typing.description: Opt-in transient typing for concrete channel mappings; static allowlists apply.

source_adapters.description: Source adapter IDs for this route.

dest_adapters.description: Destination adapter IDs for this route.

priority.description: Route matching/planning priority. Lower values run first; equal priorities break ties by expanded route_id lexicographically. This does not request transport QoS.

ownership.description: Route overlap authority. Shared routes may overlap; enabled exclusive routes must not have overlapping source match domains.

enabled.description: Whether this route is enabled at startup.

source_room.description: Optional source room ID (alias for source_channel).

dest_room.description: Optional destination room ID (alias for dest_channel).

dest_destination.description: Optional structured destination addressing (identity/hash form). Shape validated by routing-config.schema.json RouteDestination. Mutually exclusive with dest_channel and dest_room.

policy.description: Optional static bridge policy. Shape validated by routing-config.schema.json BridgePolicy.

retry.description: Optional per-route retry policy. Shape validated by routing-config.schema.json RouteRetryConfig.

context_map.description: Optional mapping of source-side opaque context strings to dest contexts or structured destinations. Shape validated by routing-config.schema.json. Contexts are opaque strings owned by their adapters.

source_origin_label.description: Source-side human-readable label for the forward leg of this route.

dest_origin_label.description: Source-side human-readable label for the reverse leg of this route.
